These events are raised when chart style information is about to be used for rendering. They provide a just-in-time hook for changing any
attributes of the style object(ChartStyleInfo) before it is used by the chart.

|  | Member name | Value | Description |
|  | None | 0 | No special action is taken. Labels may intersect. |
|  | Wrap | 1 | When labels would intersect each other, they are wrapped to avoid intersection. |
|  | MultipleRows | 2 | When labels would intersect each other, they are wrapped into multiple rows to avoid intersection. |
|  | Rotate | 3 | When labels would intersect each other, they are rotated to avoid intersection. |

| JScript |

| ``` public static function VarianceUnbiasedEstimator( 	series : ChartSeries ) : double ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.VarianceUnbiasedEstimator = function(series); ``` |

#### Parameters

series
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the Series object that stores the group of data.

#### Return Value

A double that represents the variance within the group of data.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method estimates the variance for a sample.

If the specified input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following Code demonstrate how to gets the VarianceUnBasedEstimator of the data points in a series

## File: html/0b86d240-8e74-46ad-8caa-363118773b30.htm

![Collapse image](icons/collapse_all.gif "Collapse image")![Expand Image](icons/expand_all.gif "Expand Image")![](icons/collapse_all.gif)![](icons/expand_all.gif)![](icons/dropdown.gif)![](icons/dropdownHover.gif)![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")![CopyHover image](icons/copycodeHighlight.gif "CopyHover image")

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/collapse_all.gif) Collapse AllExpand All     ![](icons/dropdown.gif) Code: All Code: Multiple Code: C# Code: Visual Basic Code: Visual C++ Code: JScript Code: JavaScript Code: XAML Code: ASP.NET |

C#
Visual Basic
Visual C++
JScript
JavaScript
XAML
ASP.NET

|  |
| --- |
| Essential Chart |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas..::..Anova Method (Double, array<ChartSeries>[]()[][], Int32) |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas Class [Example](#exampleToggle) [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Performs Anova (Analysis of variance test) on input series. All series should have the same
number of points. The tests null hypothesis assumes that all series means are equal and
that all variances of series are also equal. The alternative to null hypothesis is that there
is one inequality between means of series. For better understanding of this test, we recommend to read:
Dowdy, S. M.
Statistics for research / Shirley Dowdy, Stanley Weardon, Daniel Chilko.
p. cm. – (Wiley series in probability and statistics; 1345)

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static AnovaResult Anova( 	double probability, 	ChartSeries[] inputSeries, 	int yIndex ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function Anova ( _ 	probability As Double, _ 	inputSeries As ChartSeries(), _ 	yIndex As Integer _ ) As AnovaResult ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static AnovaResult^ Anova( 	double probability,  	array<ChartSeries^>^ inputSeries,  	int yIndex ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function Anova( 	probability : double,  	inputSeries : ChartSeries[],  	yIndex : int ) : AnovaResult ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.Anova = function(probability, inputSeries, yIndex); ``` |

#### Parameters

probability
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Probability that gives confidence level. (Typically 0.05)

inputSeries
:   Type: array<Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries>[]()[][]
    Series array

yIndex
:   Type: [System..::..Int32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/td2s409d)
    Index of the Y value.

#### Return Value

AnovaResult class

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

An ANOVA test is used to test the difference between the means of two or more groups of data.

Two or more groups of data (series) must be specified, and each series must have the same number of data points otherwise an exception will be raised.

If a specified input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following code demonstrate how to calculate AnovaTest

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics; ........ AnovaResult ar = BasicStatisticalFormulas.Anova(0.5,new ChartSeries[]{ series1, series2, series3}, 0 ); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics ........ Dim ar As AnovaResult = BasicStatisticalFormulas.Anova(0.5, New ChartSeries(){ series1, series2, series3}, 0) ``` | |

| ChartSeriesRenderer Class |
| Members [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Base class for all renderers. Each renderer is responsible for rendering one data series
(please refer to ChartSeries) inside of the chart area. ChartSeriesRenderer
provides the basic plumbing that is needed by all renderers. It is not an abstract class.
It is used as the renderer for the scatter plot since the scatter plot needs only basic
point rendering at the correct position.

You can derive from ChartSeriesRenderer to create your own renderers.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

## File: html/1424ddaf-9d53-3c6e-707a-91fe3291fa48.htm

![Collapse image](icons/collapse_all.gif "Collapse image")![Expand Image](icons/expand_all.gif "Expand Image")![](icons/collapse_all.gif)![](icons/expand_all.gif)![](icons/dropdown.gif)![](icons/dropdownHover.gif)![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")![CopyHover image](icons/copycodeHighlight.gif "CopyHover image")

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/collapse_all.gif) Collapse AllExpand All     ![](icons/dropdown.gif) Code: All Code: Multiple Code: C# Code: Visual Basic Code: Visual C++ Code: JScript Code: JavaScript Code: XAML Code: ASP.NET |

C#

ASP.NET

|  |
| --- |
| Essential Chart |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas..::..ZTest Method (Double, Double, Double, Double, ChartSeries, ChartSeries, Int32) |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas Class [Example](#exampleToggle) [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Performs Z test on input series. This test assumes that
there is some difference between mean values of input series populations.
Input series are regarded as samples from normally distributed populations
with known variances.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static ZTestResult ZTest( 	double hypothesizedMeanDifference, 	double varianceFirstGroup, 	double varianceSecondGroup, 	double probability, 	ChartSeries firstInputSeries, 	ChartSeries secondInputSeries, 	int yIndex ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function ZTest ( _ 	hypothesizedMeanDifference As Double, _ 	varianceFirstGroup As Double, _ 	varianceSecondGroup As Double, _ 	probability As Double, _ 	firstInputSeries As ChartSeries, _ 	secondInputSeries As ChartSeries, _ 	yIndex As Integer _ ) As ZTestResult ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static ZTestResult^ ZTest( 	double hypothesizedMeanDifference,  	double varianceFirstGroup,  	double varianceSecondGroup,  	double probability,  	ChartSeries^ firstInputSeries,  	ChartSeries^ secondInputSeries,  	int yIndex ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function ZTest( 	hypothesizedMeanDifference : double,  	varianceFirstGroup : double,  	varianceSecondGroup : double,  	probability : double,  	firstInputSeries : ChartSeries,  	secondInputSeries : ChartSeries,  	yIndex : int ) : ZTestResult ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.ZTest = function(hypothesizedMeanDifference, varianceFirstGroup, varianceSecondGroup, probability, firstInputSeries, secondInputSeries, yIndex); ``` |

#### Parameters

hypothesizedMeanDifference
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Difference between populations means.

varianceFirstGroup
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Variance of the first series population.

varianceSecondGroup
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Variance of the second series population.

probability
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Probability that gives confidence level. (Typically 0.05)

firstInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the first group of data..

secondInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the second group of data..

yIndex
:   Type: [System..::..Int32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/td2s409d)
    Index of the Y value.

#### Return Value

ZTestResult Class

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method performs a Z test for two groups of data, and returns the results using a ZTestResult object.

Two and only two groups of data must be specified. If either input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following code demonstrate how to calculate Ztest

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` ZTestResult ztr = BasicStatisticalFormulas.ZTest( Convert.ToDouble(TextBox6.Text.ToString()),sqrtVarianceOfFirstSeries*sqrtVarianceOfFirstSeries,sqrtVarianceOfSecondSeries* sqrtVarianceOfSecondSeries,0.05,series1,series2, 0); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Dim ztr As ZTestResult = BasicStatisticalFormulas.ZTest(Convert.ToDouble(TextBox6.Text.ToString()), sqrtVarianceOfFirstSeries*sqrtVarianceOfFirstSeries, sqrtVarianceOfSecondSeries*sqrtVarianceOfSecondSeries, 0.05, series1, series2, 0) ``` | |

| ![Public class](icons/pubclass.gif "Public class") | ChartModel | The ChartModel object acts as the central repository of data associated with and displayed by a ChartControl. There are three parts to the ChartModel. The first part is the ChartSeriesCollection instance that is held in the model. This collection holds all the ChartSeries instances that are registered with and displayed by the Chart. The Chart Model also holds a ChartBaseStylesMap instance. This collection maintains a collection of base styles that are registered with it. These base styles can be accessed and changed using this collection. Any changes made to base styles will automatically affect all style objects that depend on these base styles. Also, in the model is a ChartColorModel instance that provides access to several default color palettes for use by the ChartControl. |

## File: html/23d6eb57-cb0f-840d-289c-b3b50073da00.htm

![Collapse image](icons/collapse_all.gif "Collapse image")![Expand Image](icons/expand_all.gif "Expand Image")![](icons/collapse_all.gif)![](icons/expand_all.gif)![](icons/dropdown.gif)![](icons/dropdownHover.gif)![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")![CopyHover image](icons/copycodeHighlight.gif "CopyHover image")

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/collapse_all.gif) Collapse AllExpand All     ![](icons/dropdown.gif) Code: All Code: Multiple Code: C# Code: Visual Basic Code: Visual C++ Code: JScript Code: JavaScript Code: XAML Code: ASP.NET |

C#
Visual Basic
Visual C++
JScript
JavaScript
XAML
ASP.NET

|  |
| --- |
| Essential Chart |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas..::..TTestPaired Method (Double, Double, ChartSeries, ChartSeries, Int32) |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas Class [Example](#exampleToggle) [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Performs T test on input series. This test assumes that
there is some difference between mean values of input series populations.
Input series are regarded as samples from normally distributed populations.
The population variances are assumed to be unequal. So this method is not statistically exact,
but it works well, and sometimes is called robust T test.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static TTestResult TTestPaired( 	double hypothesizedMeanDifference, 	double probability, 	ChartSeries firstInputSeries, 	ChartSeries secondInputSeries, 	int yIndex ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function TTestPaired ( _ 	hypothesizedMeanDifference As Double, _ 	probability As Double, _ 	firstInputSeries As ChartSeries, _ 	secondInputSeries As ChartSeries, _ 	yIndex As Integer _ ) As TTestResult ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static TTestResult^ TTestPaired( 	double hypothesizedMeanDifference,  	double probability,  	ChartSeries^ firstInputSeries,  	ChartSeries^ secondInputSeries,  	int yIndex ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function TTestPaired( 	hypothesizedMeanDifference : double,  	probability : double,  	firstInputSeries : ChartSeries,  	secondInputSeries : ChartSeries,  	yIndex : int ) : TTestResult ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.TTestPaired = function(hypothesizedMeanDifference, probability, firstInputSeries, secondInputSeries, yIndex); ``` |

#### Parameters

hypothesizedMeanDifference
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Difference between populations means.

probability
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Probability that gives confidence level. (Typically 0.05)

firstInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the first group of data.

secondInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the second group of data.

yIndex
:   Type: [System..::..Int32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/td2s409d)
    Index of the Y value.

#### Return Value

TTestResult class

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method performs a paired two-sample student's t-test to determine whether a sample's means are distinct. This form of the t-test does not assume that the variances of both populations are equal.

Use a paired test when there is a natural pairing of observations in the samples, such as a sample group that is tested twice (e.g. before and after an experiment).

If either input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following code demonstrate how to calculate TTestPaired

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics; ........ TTestResult ttr = BasicStatisticalFormulas.TTestPaired(0.2, 0.05, series1, series2, 0); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics ........ Dim ttr As TTestResult = BasicStatisticalFormulas.TTestPaired (0.2, 0.05, series1, series2, 0) ``` | |

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

ChartControl is the root class of the chart control.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Windows (in Syncfusion.Chart.Windows.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public class ChartControl : Control,  	IChartAreaHost ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Class ChartControl _ 	Inherits Control _ 	Implements IChartAreaHost ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public ref class ChartControl : public Control,  	IChartAreaHost ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public class ChartControl extends Control implements IChartAreaHost ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.ChartControl = function();  Type.createClass( 	'Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.ChartControl', 	Control, 	Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.IChartAreaHost); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

The ChartControl lets you create enterprise level charts with support for numerous chart types (see Type).
A ChartSeries containing pints of X and Y values can be added to the Series collection to get a chart
rendered. The chart control has a built in "nice range calculation" engine which will automatically determine the appropriate
ranges for the axes based on the series data. Chart readily supports rendering multiple series.

There is also support for multiple axes, in case you want to render multiple series with each series rendered against a unique axes.
Use the Axes collection to add one or more custom axis to the default set of PrimaryXAxis and PrimaryYAxis,
which also can be referred from the Axes collection. Numerous customization can be done on the axis labels through the
corresponding ChartAxis instance.

The default Legend renders some default ChartLegendItems representing each series in the chart.
You can add custom legends to the chart through the Legends collection. You can add custom legend items to the
ChartLegend instance through the CustomItems collection.

There is also a default Title and the ability to add multiple titles through the Titles collection.

The look and feel of the plot can also be customized through the ChartArea property.

There is also built in support for applying some statistical formulas and functions to the series data. Take a look
at the BasicStatisticalFormulas type and the UtilityFunctions type.4

|  | Member name | Value | Description |
|  | Disabled | 0 | Labels are not shown. |
|  | Inside | 1 | Labels are rendered inside the pie. |
|  | Outside | 2 | Lables are rendered outside the pie.In funnel or pyramid chart, if the label style is set to outside, then the label placement has be left or right. |

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Calculates variance of series Y values.

**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

| Visual Basic |

| ``` Public Shared Function VarianceBiasedEstimator ( _ 	series As ChartSeries, _ 	yIndex As Integer _ ) As Double ``` |

| ``` public static function VarianceBiasedEstimator( 	series : ChartSeries,  	yIndex : int ) : double ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.VarianceBiasedEstimator = function(series, yIndex); ``` |

#### Parameters

series
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the Series object that stores the group of data.

yIndex
:   Type: [System..::..Int32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/td2s409d)
    Index of the Y value.

#### Return Value

A double that represents the variance within the group of data.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method estimates the variance for a sample.

If the specified input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following Code demonstrate how to gets the VarianceBasedEstimator of the data points in a series

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |

| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics; ............ double VarianceBased1= Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.VarianceBiasedEstimator(series, 0); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics ............. Dim VarianceBased1 As Double VarianceBased1=BasicStatisticalFormulas.VarianceBiasedEstimator(series, 0) ``` | |

| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ShowMarker | Gets or sets a value indicating whether marker is visible. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Symbol | Gets or sets the symbol information that is to be associated with the custom point. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Text | Gets or sets the text of the custom point. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | XValue | Gets or sets the Y value of the custom point when the primary Y axis of the chart is of type double. |

| ChartSeriesRenderer..::..IgnoreSeriesInversion Property |
| ChartSeriesRenderer Class [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

This setting allows chart types that are normally not rendered inverted to be combined with those that are
normally rendered inverted. For example Bar charts are rendered inverted. The Bubble chart can be combined with
Bar charts because it sets IgnoreSeriesInversion to true. When this property is set to true the renderer will ignore
the inversion setting on the series being rendered.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart

## File: html/47db52dc-21ba-5693-0e93-d80e675a84e9.htm

![Collapse image](icons/collapse_all.gif "Collapse image")![Expand Image](icons/expand_all.gif "Expand Image")![](icons/collapse_all.gif)![](icons/expand_all.gif)![](icons/dropdown.gif)![](icons/dropdownHover.gif)![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")![CopyHover image](icons/copycodeHighlight.gif "CopyHover image")

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/collapse_all.gif) Collapse AllExpand All     ![](icons/dropdown.gif) Code: All Code: Multiple Code: C# Code: Visual Basic Code: Visual C++ Code: JScript Code: JavaScript Code: XAML Code: ASP.NET |

C#
Visual Basic
Visual C++
JScript
JavaScript
XAML
ASP.NET

|  |
| --- |
| Essential Chart |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas..::..TTestUnEqualVariances Method (Double, Double, ChartSeries, ChartSeries, Int32) |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas Class [Example](#exampleToggle) [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Performs T test on input series. This test assumes that
there is some difference between mean values of input series populations.
Input series are regarded as samples from normally distributed populations.
The population variances are assumed to be unequal. So this method is not statistically exact,
but it works well, and sometimes is called robust T test.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static TTestResult TTestUnEqualVariances( 	double hypothesizedMeanDifference, 	double probability, 	ChartSeries firstInputSeries, 	ChartSeries secondInputSeries, 	int yIndex ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function TTestUnEqualVariances ( _ 	hypothesizedMeanDifference As Double, _ 	probability As Double, _ 	firstInputSeries As ChartSeries, _ 	secondInputSeries As ChartSeries, _ 	yIndex As Integer _ ) As TTestResult ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static TTestResult^ TTestUnEqualVariances( 	double hypothesizedMeanDifference,  	double probability,  	ChartSeries^ firstInputSeries,  	ChartSeries^ secondInputSeries,  	int yIndex ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function TTestUnEqualVariances( 	hypothesizedMeanDifference : double,  	probability : double,  	firstInputSeries : ChartSeries,  	secondInputSeries : ChartSeries,  	yIndex : int ) : TTestResult ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.TTestUnEqualVariances = function(hypothesizedMeanDifference, probability, firstInputSeries, secondInputSeries, yIndex); ``` |

#### Parameters

hypothesizedMeanDifference
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Difference between populations means.

probability
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Probability that gives confidence level. (Typically 0.05)

firstInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the first group of data.

secondInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the second group of data.

yIndex
:   Type: [System..::..Int32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/td2s409d)
    Index of the Y value.

#### Return Value

TTestResult class

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method performs a T test for two groups of data, and assumes unequal variances between the two groups (i.e. series).

This analysis tool is referred to as a heteroscedastic t-test, and can be used when the groups under study are distinct. Use a paired test when there is one group before and after a treatment.

If either input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following code demonstrate how to calculate TTest UnEqual Variance

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics; ........ TTestResult ttr = BasicStatisticalFormulas.TTestUnEqualVariances (0.2, 0.05, series1, series2, 0); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics ........ Dim ttr As TTestResult = BasicStatisticalFormulas.TTestUnEqualVariances (0.2, 0.05, series1, series2, 0) ``` | |

## File: html/4937a04f-6cba-3fda-d1e3-785605731910.htm

![Collapse image](icons/collapse_all.gif "Collapse image")![Expand Image](icons/expand_all.gif "Expand Image")![](icons/collapse_all.gif)![](icons/expand_all.gif)![](icons/dropdown.gif)![](icons/dropdownHover.gif)![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")![CopyHover image](icons/copycodeHighlight.gif "CopyHover image")

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/collapse_all.gif) Collapse AllExpand All     ![](icons/dropdown.gif) Code: All Code: Multiple Code: C# Code: Visual Basic Code: Visual C++ Code: JScript Code: JavaScript Code: XAML Code: ASP.NET |

C#
Visual Basic
Visual C++
JScript
JavaScript
XAML
ASP.NET

|  |
| --- |
| Essential Chart |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas..::..Anova Method (Double, array<ChartSeries>[]()[][]) |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas Class [Example](#exampleToggle) [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Performs Anova (Analysis of variance test) on input series. All series should have the same
number of points. The tests null hypothesis assumes that all series means are equal and
that all variances of series are also equal. The alternative to null hypothesis is that there
is one inequality between means of series. For better understanding of this test, we recommend to read:
Dowdy, S. M.
Statistics for research / Shirley Dowdy, Stanley Weardon, Daniel Chilko.
p. cm. – (Wiley series in probability and statistics; 1345)

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static AnovaResult Anova( 	double probability, 	ChartSeries[] inputSeries ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function Anova ( _ 	probability As Double, _ 	inputSeries As ChartSeries() _ ) As AnovaResult ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static AnovaResult^ Anova( 	double probability,  	array<ChartSeries^>^ inputSeries ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function Anova( 	probability : double,  	inputSeries : ChartSeries[] ) : AnovaResult ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.Anova = function(probability, inputSeries); ``` |

#### Parameters

probability
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Probability that gives confidence level. (Typically 0.05)

inputSeries
:   Type: array<Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries>[]()[][]
    Series array

#### Return Value

AnovaResult class

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

An ANOVA test is used to test the difference between the means of two or more groups of data.

Two or more groups of data (series) must be specified, and each series must have the same number of data points otherwise an exception will be raised.

If a specified input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following code demonstrate how to calculate AnovaTest

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics; ........ AnovaResult ar = BasicStatisticalFormulas.Anova(0.5,new ChartSeries[]{ series1, series2, series3} ); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics ........ Dim ar As AnovaResult = BasicStatisticalFormulas.Anova(0.5, New ChartSeries(){ series1, series2, series3}) ``` | |

## File: html/4be83fea-ce78-4d59-9780-135c5efeaac7.htm

![Collapse image](icons/collapse_all.gif "Collapse image")![Expand Image](icons/expand_all.gif "Expand Image")![](icons/collapse_all.gif)![](icons/expand_all.gif)![](icons/dropdown.gif)![](icons/dropdownHover.gif)![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")![CopyHover image](icons/copycodeHighlight.gif "CopyHover image")

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/collapse_all.gif) Collapse AllExpand All     ![](icons/dropdown.gif) Code: All Code: Multiple Code: C# Code: Visual Basic Code: Visual C++ Code: JScript Code: JavaScript Code: XAML Code: ASP.NET |

C#
Visual Basic
Visual C++
JScript
JavaScript
XAML
ASP.NET

|  |
| --- |
| Essential Chart |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas..::..TTestUnEqualVariances Method (Double, Double, ChartSeries, ChartSeries) |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas Class [Example](#exampleToggle) [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Performs T test on input series. This test assumes that
there is some difference between mean values of input series populations.
Input series are regarded as samples from normally distributed populations.
The population variances are assumed to be unequal. So this method is not statistically exact,
but it works well, and sometimes is called robust T test.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static TTestResult TTestUnEqualVariances( 	double hypothesizedMeanDifference, 	double probability, 	ChartSeries firstInputSeries, 	ChartSeries secondInputSeries ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function TTestUnEqualVariances ( _ 	hypothesizedMeanDifference As Double, _ 	probability As Double, _ 	firstInputSeries As ChartSeries, _ 	secondInputSeries As ChartSeries _ ) As TTestResult ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static TTestResult^ TTestUnEqualVariances( 	double hypothesizedMeanDifference,  	double probability,  	ChartSeries^ firstInputSeries,  	ChartSeries^ secondInputSeries ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function TTestUnEqualVariances( 	hypothesizedMeanDifference : double,  	probability : double,  	firstInputSeries : ChartSeries,  	secondInputSeries : ChartSeries ) : TTestResult ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.TTestUnEqualVariances = function(hypothesizedMeanDifference, probability, firstInputSeries, secondInputSeries); ``` |

#### Parameters

hypothesizedMeanDifference
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Difference between populations means.

probability
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Probability that gives confidence level. (Typically 0.05)

firstInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the first group of data.

secondInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the second group of data.

#### Return Value

TTestResult class

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method performs a T test for two groups of data, and assumes unequal variances between the two groups (i.e. series).

This analysis tool is referred to as a heteroscedastic t-test, and can be used when the groups under study are distinct. Use a paired test when there is one group before and after a treatment.

If either input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following code demonstrate how to calculate TTest UnEqual Variance

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics; ........ TTestResult ttr = BasicStatisticalFormulas.TTestUnEqualVariances (0.2, 0.05, series1, series2); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics ........ Dim ttr As TTestResult = BasicStatisticalFormulas.TTestUnEqualVariances (0.2, 0.05, series1, series2) ``` | |

## File: html/4dba2f93-de36-8ce0-8e76-d0af50ae94a0.htm

![Collapse image](icons/collapse_all.gif "Collapse image")![Expand Image](icons/expand_all.gif "Expand Image")![](icons/collapse_all.gif)![](icons/expand_all.gif)![](icons/dropdown.gif)![](icons/dropdownHover.gif)![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")![CopyHover image](icons/copycodeHighlight.gif "CopyHover image")

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/collapse_all.gif) Collapse AllExpand All     ![](icons/dropdown.gif) Code: All Code: Multiple Code: C# Code: Visual Basic Code: Visual C++ Code: JScript Code: JavaScript Code: XAML Code: ASP.NET |

C#
Visual Basic
Visual C++
JScript
JavaScript
XAML
ASP.NET

|  |
| --- |
| Essential Chart |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas..::..TTestPaired Method (Double, Double, ChartSeries, ChartSeries) |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas Class [Example](#exampleToggle) [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Performs T test on input series. This test assumes that
there is some difference between mean values of input series populations.
Input series are regarded as samples from normally distributed populations.
The population variances are assumed to be unequal. So this method is not statistically exact,
but it works well, and sometimes is called robust T test.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static TTestResult TTestPaired( 	double hypothesizedMeanDifference, 	double probability, 	ChartSeries firstInputSeries, 	ChartSeries secondInputSeries ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function TTestPaired ( _ 	hypothesizedMeanDifference As Double, _ 	probability As Double, _ 	firstInputSeries As ChartSeries, _ 	secondInputSeries As ChartSeries _ ) As TTestResult ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static TTestResult^ TTestPaired( 	double hypothesizedMeanDifference,  	double probability,  	ChartSeries^ firstInputSeries,  	ChartSeries^ secondInputSeries ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function TTestPaired( 	hypothesizedMeanDifference : double,  	probability : double,  	firstInputSeries : ChartSeries,  	secondInputSeries : ChartSeries ) : TTestResult ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.TTestPaired = function(hypothesizedMeanDifference, probability, firstInputSeries, secondInputSeries); ``` |

#### Parameters

hypothesizedMeanDifference
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Difference between populations means.

probability
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Probability that gives confidence level. (Typically 0.05)

firstInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the first group of data.

secondInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the second group of data.

#### Return Value

TTestResult class

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method performs a paired two-sample student's t-test to determine whether a sample's means are distinct. This form of the t-test does not assume that the variances of both populations are equal.

Use a paired test when there is a natural pairing of observations in the samples, such as a sample group that is tested twice (e.g. before and after an experiment).

If either input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following code demonstrate how to calculate TTestPaired

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics; ........ TTestResult ttr = BasicStatisticalFormulas.TTestPaired(0.2, 0.05, series1, series2); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics ........ Dim ttr As TTestResult = BasicStatisticalFormulas.TTestPaired (0.2, 0.05, series1, series2) ``` | |

| ChartModel Class |
| Members [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The ChartModel object acts as the central repository of data associated with and displayed by a ChartControl.
There are three parts to the ChartModel. The first part is the ChartSeriesCollection instance that is held in the model.
This collection holds all the ChartSeries instances that are registered with and displayed by the Chart. The Chart Model also
holds a ChartBaseStylesMap instance. This collection maintains a collection of base styles that are registered with it.
These base styles can be accessed and changed using this collection. Any changes made to base styles will automatically affect all style
objects that depend on these base styles. Also, in the model is a ChartColorModel instance that provides access to several default
color palettes for use by the ChartControl.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Members

|  | Member name | Value | Description |
|  | UpLeft | 0 | Text is rendered above and to the left of the point. |
|  | Up | 1 | Text is rendered above the point. |
|  | UpRight | 2 | Text is rendered above and to the right of the point. |
|  | Left | 3 | Text is rendered to the left of the point. |
|  | Center | 4 | Text is centered on the point. |
|  | Right | 5 | Text is rendered to the right of the point. |
|  | DownLeft | 6 | Text is rendered below and to the left of the point. |
|  | Down | 7 | Text is rendered below the point. |
|  | DownRight | 8 | Text is rendered below and to the right of the point. |
|  | Smart | 9 | Text is rendered in a manner that is appropriate for the situation. |
|  | RegionUp | 10 | Text is rendered above the region that represents the point (Example: above the bar in a bar chart). |
|  | RegionDown | 11 | Text is rendered below the region that represents the point (Example: below the bar in a bar chart). |
|  | RegionCenter | 12 | Text is centered in the region that represents the point (Example: centered inside the bar in a bar chart). |
|  | SymbolCenter | 13 | Text is centered to the symbol if one is associated with the point. |

| ![Protected method](icons/protmethod.gif "Protected method") | OnPrepareSeriesStyleInfo | After composing the style of each series, the chart's style system will call this method before the style is used for display. Override this method if you wish to change the contents of the series ChartStyleInfo object that is passed in. For instance, if you wish to change the back color of the series being rendered based on external criteria, you could check this criteria when this method gets called and change the color of the series based on such. Note that any changes made to the style object in this method are not permanent but are temporary and lasts only for the current rendering cycle. This makes this method a convenient place to set transient data based attributes. |

For instance, if you wish to change the back color of the series point being rendered based on external criteria, you could check this criteria when this method gets called and change the color of the point based on such. Note that any changes made to the style object in this method are not permanent but are temporary and lasts only for the current rendering cycle. This makes this method a convenient place to set transient data based attributes. |

| Visual Basic |

| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.VarianceUnbiasedEstimator = function(series, yIndex); ``` |

#### Parameters

series
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the Series object that stores the group of data.

yIndex
:   Type: [System..::..Int32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/td2s409d)
    Index of the Y value.

#### Return Value

A double that represents the variance within the group of data.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method estimates the variance for a sample.

If the specified input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following Code demonstrate how to gets the VarianceUnBasedEstimator of the data points in a series

    The input series

:   Type: [System..::..Int32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/td2s409d)
    Index of the Y index.

#### Return Value

[Missing <returns> documentation for "M:Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.Median(Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.ChartSeries,System.Int32)"]

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

Use this method to calculate the median of the points stored in a series.
The median is the middle value of a sample set, where half of the members are greater in size and half the members are lesser in size.

if the specified input series does not exist in the SeriesCollection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following Code demonstrate how to gets the median of the data points in a series

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics; ............ double Median1= Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.Median(series1, 0); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics ............. Dim Median1 As Double Median1=BasicStatisticalFormulas.Median(series1, 0) ``` | |

#### Parameters

index

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Properties

|  | Name | Description |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | DegreeOfFreedomBetweenGroups | Gets degrees of freedom between groups. This is simply a - 1, where a is number of series in anova test. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | DegreeOfFreedomTotal | Gets total degrees of freedom. This is simply n\*a - 1, where a is number of series in anova test, and n is number of points in series. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | DegreeOfFreedomWithinGroups | Gets degrees of freedom within groups ( returns a\*(n - 1) ). |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | FCriticalValue | Gets critical value of FRatio which corresponds to specified confidence probability. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | FRatio | Gets FRatio ( ratio of between group variance and within group variance). This ratio should be compared with FCritical value, and if it is farther from unity than FCritical value, then the null hypothesis (that all means are equal) fails. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | MeanSquareVarianceBetweenGroups | Gets mean square variance between groups. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | MeanSquareVarianceWithinGroups | Gets mean square variance within groups. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | SumOfSquaresBetweenGroups | Gets sum of squares between groups. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | SumOfSquaresTotal | Gets total sum of squares. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | SumOfSquaresWithinGroups | Gets sum of squares within groups. |

This test looks whether first series variance is smaller than second series variance. If FValue in FTestResult is bigger than FCriticalValueOneTail than we can't deduce that it is truly smaller. The test tests ratio of two variances s1^2/s2^2 which is proved to be distributed according F distribution. The null hypothesis is that variances are equal. |

This test looks whether first series variance is smaller than second series variance. If FValue in FTestResult is bigger than FCriticalValueOneTail than we can't deduce that it is truly smaller. The test tests ratio of two variances s1^2/s2^2 which is proved to be distributed according F distribution. The null hypothesis is that variances are equal. |

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The Chart Region represents a region on the client area of the Chart control that has a ToolTip.
It can be a point region. A point region is a region that represents the visual appearance of a point.
For example, the Rectangle of a Column point. When the ChartRegion represents a chart point, IsChartPoint is set to True.

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Calculates variance of series X values.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static double StandardDeviation( 	ChartSeries series, 	bool sampleVariance ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function StandardDeviation ( _ 	series As ChartSeries, _ 	sampleVariance As Boolean _ ) As Double ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static double StandardDeviation( 	ChartSeries^ series,  	bool sampleVariance ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function StandardDeviation( 	series : ChartSeries,  	sampleVariance : boolean ) : double ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.StandardDeviation = function(series, sampleVariance); ``` |

#### Parameters

series
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the Series object that stores the group of data.

sampleVariance
:   Type: [System..::..Boolean](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/a28wyd50)
    True if the data is a sample of a population, false if it is the entire population.

#### Return Value

A double that represents the Standard Deviation within the group of data.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method estimates the Standard Deviation for a sample.

If the specified input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following Code demonstrate how to gets the Standard Deviation of the data points in a series

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics;    ............    double Standard1= Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.StandartDeviation(series,false); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics    .............    Dim Standard1 As Double    Standard1=BasicStatisticalFormulas.StandartDeviation(series,false) ``` | |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Classes

|  | Class | Description |
| ![Public class](icons/pubclass.gif "Public class") | AnovaResult | Result of Anova test is stored in this class. If AnovaResult.FRatio is farther from unity than FCritical value, then the null hypothesis (that all means are equal) fails. |
| ![Public class](icons/pubclass.gif "Public class") | BasicStatisticalFormulas | The BasicStatisticalFormulas class provides the functionality for the Basic Statistical formulas Mean,Median, . |
| ![Public class](icons/pubclass.gif "Public class") | FTestResult | The result of statistical F test is stored in this class. If the F value is closer to 1.0 than FCriticalValueOneTail, then we can't deduce that first variance is smaller than second. But if F value is bigger than 1.0, then replace the series and run the test again. Maybe second series variance is smaller than first. Note: That if the second test also fails, this doesn't automatically prove that your variances are equal. |
| ![Public class](icons/pubclass.gif "Public class") | TTestResult | The result of statistical T test is stored in this class. If the T value is closer to 0.0 than TCriticalValueTwoTail or even TCriticalValueOneTail, then we can't deduce that D(hypothesized difference) is not good mean value difference. In other case ( TCriticalValueTwoTail is closer to 0.0 than TValue), there is a huge probability that hypothesized difference D hadn't been chosen correctly. |
| ![Public class](icons/pubclass.gif "Public class") | UtilityFunctions | Class contains Gamma, factorial, Beta and other functions used in statistical distributions formulas. |
| ![Public class](icons/pubclass.gif "Public class") | ZTestResult | The result of statistical Z test is stored in this class. If the Z value is closer to 0.0 than ZCriticalValueTwoTail or even ZCriticalValueOneTail, then we can't deduce that D(hypothesized difference) is not good mean value difference. In other case ( ZCriticalValueTwoTail is closer to 0.0 than ZValue), there is a huge probability that hypothesized difference D hadn't been chosen correctly. |

| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Spacing | Gets or sets the spacing between the element borders and the control |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Style | Gets or sets the style of the ChartLegend. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | TabIndex | Gets or sets the tab order of the control within its container. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Text | Gets or sets the text associated with this control. (Overrides [Control..::..Text](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/1x029774).) |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | TextAlignment | Gets or sets the alignment of the text. Default is Center. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | TextColor | **Obsolete.**  Gets or sets the color of the text. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | VisibleCheckBox | Gets or sets a value indicating whether the checkbox of the legend is visible. If visible, the user can use the checkbox to show/hide the whole series. |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Events

|  | Name | Description |
| ![Public event](icons/pubevent.gif "Public event") | DrawItem | Fired when a legend item needs to draw. Handle this event to change the drawing of items. |
| ![Public event](icons/pubevent.gif "Public event") | DrawItemText | Fired when a legend item text needs to draw. Handle this event to change the drawing of items text |
| ![Public event](icons/pubevent.gif "Public event") | FilterItems | Fired when the legend items need to be filtered. Handle this event to change the collection of LegendItems that the legend contains. |
| ![Public event](icons/pubevent.gif "Public event") | MinSize | Fired when the legend's minimum size is to be fixed. |

| BasicStatisticalFormulas Class [Example](#exampleToggle) [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Calculates variance of series Y values.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static double Variance( 	ChartSeries series, 	int yIndex, 	bool sampleVariance ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function Variance ( _ 	series As ChartSeries, _ 	yIndex As Integer, _ 	sampleVariance As Boolean _ ) As Double ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static double Variance( 	ChartSeries^ series,  	int yIndex,  	bool sampleVariance ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function Variance( 	series : ChartSeries,  	yIndex : int,  	sampleVariance : boolean ) : double ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.Variance = function(series, yIndex, sampleVariance); ``` |

#### Parameters

series
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the Series object that stores the group of data.

yIndex
:   Type: [System..::..Int32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/td2s409d)
    Index of the Y value.

sampleVariance
:   Type: [System..::..Boolean](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/a28wyd50)
    True if the data is a sample of a population, false if it is the entire population.

#### Return Value

A double that represents the variance within the group of data.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method estimates the variance for a sample.

If the specified input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following Code demonstrate how to gets the Variance of the data points in a series

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics; ............ double Variance1= Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.Variance(series,true); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics ............. Dim Variance1 As Double Variance1=BasicStatisticalFormulas.Variance(series,true) ``` | |

| Essential Chart |
| ChartAxis..::..DesiredIntervals Property |
| ChartAxis Class [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Gets or sets the desired number of intervals for the range. Essential Chart includes a sophisticated automatic nice range calculation engine. The goal of this engine is to take
raw data and convert it into human readable numbers. For example, if your raw numbers are 1.2 - 3.87, nice numbers could
be 0-5 with 10 intervals of 0.5 each. The ChartAxis can do the same calculation for dates also. It offers precise control over
how data types are to be interpreted when performing this calculation. With the DesiredIntervals setting, you can request the
engine to calculate nice numbers such that they result in the number of intervals desired. Due to the nature of the calculation,
the ChartAxis cannot provide precisely the same number of intervals but it will try to match the value to the extent possible.

| Essential Chart |
| ChartSeries..::..OnPrepareStyleInfo Method |
| ChartSeries Class [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

After composing the style of each point in a series, the chart's style system will call this method before the style is used for display.
Override this method if you wish to change the contents of the ChartStyleInfo object that is passed in. For instance, if
you wish to change the back color of the series point being rendered based on external criteria, you could check this criteria when this
method gets called and change the color of the point based on such. Note that any changes made to the style object in this method
are not permanent but are temporary and lasts only for the current rendering cycle. This makes this method
a convenient place to set transient data based attributes.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

| TTestResult Class |
| Members [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The result of statistical T test is stored in this class.
If the T value is closer to 0.0 than TCriticalValueTwoTail or
even TCriticalValueOneTail, then we can't deduce that D(hypothesized difference) is not
good mean value difference. In other case ( TCriticalValueTwoTail is closer to 0.0
than TValue), there is a huge probability that hypothesized difference D hadn't been
chosen correctly.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics

    The name of the Series object that stores the group of data.

#### Return Value

A double that represents the variance within the group of data.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method estimates the variance for a sample.

If the specified input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

| ZTestResult Class |
| Members [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The result of statistical Z test is stored in this class.
If the Z value is closer to 0.0 than ZCriticalValueTwoTail or
even ZCriticalValueOneTail, then we can't deduce that D(hypothesized difference) is not
good mean value difference. In other case ( ZCriticalValueTwoTail is closer to 0.0
than ZValue), there is a huge probability that hypothesized difference D hadn't been
chosen correctly.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

| FTestResult Class |
| Members [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The result of statistical F test is stored in this class.
If the F value is closer to 1.0 than FCriticalValueOneTail, then we can't deduce that first variance
is smaller than second. But if F value is bigger than 1.0, then replace the series and run the
test again. Maybe second series variance is smaller than first.
Note: That if the second test also fails, this doesn't automatically prove that your variances
are equal.

|  |

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Inverse Normal Distribution function.
This is rational approximation of Normal Distribution function.
The absolute value of the relative error is less than 1.15·10-9 in the entire region.
Lower tail quantile for standard normal distribution function.
This function returns an approximation of the inverse cumulative
standard normal distribution function. I.e., given P, it returns
an approximation to the X satisfying P = Pr{Z is smaller than X} where Z is a
random variable from the standard normal distribution.

|  | SeriesImage | 2 | The image associated with the series type will be rendered. |
|  | Rectangle | 3 | A rectangle will be rendered. |
|  | Line | 4 | A line will be rendered. |
|  | StraightLine | 5 | A straight line will be rendered. |
|  | Circle | 6 | A circle will be rendered. |
|  | Diamond | 7 | A diamond will be rendered. |
|  | Hexagon | 8 | A hexagon will be rendered. |
|  | Pentagon | 9 | A pentagon will be rendered. |
|  | Triangle | 10 | A triangle will be rendered. |
|  | InvertedTriangle | 11 | An inverted triangle will be rendered. |
|  | Cross | 12 | A cross will be rendered. |

The special case being situations where the X value is not needed. When you implement IChartSeriesIndexedModel and set it to this property,
the chart will internally create an adapter that implements IChartSeriesModel and treat it as any other model.

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

ChartStyleInfoSubObject is an abstract base class for classes
to be used as sub-objects in a ChartStyleInfo.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public abstract class ChartStyleInfoSubObject : ChartSubStyleInfoBase ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public MustInherit Class ChartStyleInfoSubObject _ 	Inherits ChartSubStyleInfoBase ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public ref class ChartStyleInfoSubObject abstract : public ChartSubStyleInfoBase ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public abstract class ChartStyleInfoSubObject extends ChartSubStyleInfoBase ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.ChartStyleInfoSubObject = function();  Type.createClass( 	'Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.ChartStyleInfoSubObject', 	Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.ChartSubStyleInfoBase); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

ChartStyleInfoSubObject is derived from StyleInfoBase
and thus provides the same easy way to provide properties that can inherit values
from base styles at run-time.The difference is that ChartStyleInfoSubObject supports this inheritance
mechanism as a sub-object from a ChartStyleInfo. A sub-object needs to
have knowledge about its parent object and be able to walk the base styles from the
parent object.Examples for implementation of ChartStyleInfoSubObject is the font
class in Essential Chart.Programmers can derive their own style classes from ChartStyleInfoSubObject
and add type-safe (and Intelli-sense)
supported custom properties to the style class.See the overview of StyleInfoBase for further discussion about style objects.

|  |

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

This class provides an easy interface to interact with the underlying data points contained in the IChartSeriesModel associated
with the ChartSeries that contains this data. Even though you are interacting with a friendly object model, the ChartPoint
itself stores no data. It simply delegates to the underlying model that the ChartSeries is displaying.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Properties

|  | Name | Description |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | DegreeOfFreedomBetweenGroups | Gets degrees of freedom between groups. This is simply a - 1, where a is number of series in anova test. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | DegreeOfFreedomTotal | Gets total degrees of freedom. This is simply n\*a - 1, where a is number of series in anova test, and n is number of points in series. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | DegreeOfFreedomWithinGroups | Gets degrees of freedom within groups ( returns a\*(n - 1) ). |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | FCriticalValue | Gets critical value of FRatio which corresponds to specified confidence probability. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | FRatio | Gets FRatio ( ratio of between group variance and within group variance). This ratio should be compared with FCritical value, and if it is farther from unity than FCritical value, then the null hypothesis (that all means are equal) fails. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | MeanSquareVarianceBetweenGroups | Gets mean square variance between groups. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | MeanSquareVarianceWithinGroups | Gets mean square variance within groups. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | SumOfSquaresBetweenGroups | Gets sum of squares between groups. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | SumOfSquaresTotal | Gets total sum of squares. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | SumOfSquaresWithinGroups | Gets sum of squares within groups. |

| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Indexed | Specifies if this chart is to be rendered in indexed mode. By default, chart points have X and Y values, both of which are taken into account for plotting. In indexed mode, the X values are ignored. The X axis purely represents the position of the points and not their X value. This mode is useful when representing data that has no real X axis value except position. For example, sales of two months side-by-side. |

| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ZoomFactorX | Gets or sets the ZoomFactor. The zooming factor is the value by which intervals are multiplied to have the effect of a more fine grained range. For example, if the calculated interval is 5 and the zoom factor is 0.5, then the zoomed interval with this zoom factor will be 2.5. Therefore, there will be twice as many interval points across the same range. Scrollbars will automatically appear to allow any section of the zoomed range to be viewed. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ZoomFactorY | The zooming factor is the value by which intervals are multiplied to have the effect of a more fine grained range. For example, if the calculated interval is 5 and the zoom factor is 0.5, then the zoomed interval with this zoom factor will be 2.5. Therefore, there will be twice as many interval points across the same range. Scrollbars will automatically appear to allow any section of the zoomed range to be viewed. |

This test assumes that there is some difference between mean values of input series populations. Input series are regarded as samples from normally distributed populations. | Essential Chart |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas..::..FTest Method (Double, ChartSeries, ChartSeries) |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas Class [Example](#exampleToggle) [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Performs F test on input series. This test looks whether first series variance is smaller than second series variance.
If FValue in FTestResult is bigger than FCriticalValueOneTail than we can't deduce that it is truly smaller.
The test tests ratio of two variances s1^2/s2^2 which is proved to be distributed
according F distribution. The null hypothesis is that variances are equal.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static FTestResult FTest( 	double probability, 	ChartSeries firstInputSeries, 	ChartSeries secondInputSeries ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function FTest ( _ 	probability As Double, _ 	firstInputSeries As ChartSeries, _ 	secondInputSeries As ChartSeries _ ) As FTestResult ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static FTestResult^ FTest( 	double probability,  	ChartSeries^ firstInputSeries,  	ChartSeries^ secondInputSeries ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function FTest( 	probability : double,  	firstInputSeries : ChartSeries,  	secondInputSeries : ChartSeries ) : FTestResult ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.FTest = function(probability, firstInputSeries, secondInputSeries); ``` |

#### Parameters

probability
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Probability that gives confidence level. (Typically 0.05)

firstInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the first group of data.

secondInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the second group of data.

#### Return Value

FTestResult class

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method returns the results of the F-test using an FTestResult object.

FTest performs a two-sample F-test to compare two population variances. For example, it can be used to determine whether the time scores in a swimming meet have a difference in variance for samples from two teams.

If a specified input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following code demonstrate how to calculate FTest.

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics; ........ FTestResult ftr = BasicStatisticalFormulas.FTest(0.05, series1, series2); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics ........ Dim ftr As FTestResult = BasicStatisticalFormulas.FTest(0.05, series1, series2) ``` | |

|  | Line | 1 | Renders a Radar chart such that points are connected but the enclosed region is not filled. |
|  | Symbol | 2 | Renders a Radar chart such that points are rendered with the associated symbol. They are not connected to each other. |

## File: html/9b93a79f-d1b9-0856-3843-069b4d7bc174.htm

![Collapse image](icons/collapse_all.gif "Collapse image")![Expand Image](icons/expand_all.gif "Expand Image")![](icons/collapse_all.gif)![](icons/expand_all.gif)![](icons/dropdown.gif)![](icons/dropdownHover.gif)![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")![CopyHover image](icons/copycodeHighlight.gif "CopyHover image")

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/collapse_all.gif) Collapse AllExpand All     ![](icons/dropdown.gif) Code: All Code: Multiple Code: C# Code: Visual Basic Code: Visual C++ Code: JScript Code: JavaScript Code: XAML Code: ASP.NET |

C#
Visual Basic
Visual C++
JScript

XAML
ASP.NET

|  |
| --- |
| Essential Chart |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas..::..FTest Method (Double, ChartSeries, ChartSeries, Int32) |
| BasicStatisticalFormulas Class [Example](#exampleToggle) [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Performs F test on input series. This test looks whether first series variance is smaller than second series variance.
If FValue in FTestResult is bigger than FCriticalValueOneTail than we can't deduce that it is truly smaller.
The test tests ratio of two variances s1^2/s2^2 which is proved to be distributed
according F distribution. The null hypothesis is that variances are equal.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static FTestResult FTest( 	double probability, 	ChartSeries firstInputSeries, 	ChartSeries secondInputSeries, 	int yIndex ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function FTest ( _ 	probability As Double, _ 	firstInputSeries As ChartSeries, _ 	secondInputSeries As ChartSeries, _ 	yIndex As Integer _ ) As FTestResult ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static FTestResult^ FTest( 	double probability,  	ChartSeries^ firstInputSeries,  	ChartSeries^ secondInputSeries,  	int yIndex ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function FTest( 	probability : double,  	firstInputSeries : ChartSeries,  	secondInputSeries : ChartSeries,  	yIndex : int ) : FTestResult ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.FTest = function(probability, firstInputSeries, secondInputSeries, yIndex); ``` |

#### Parameters

probability
:   Type: [System..::..Double](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/643eft0t)
    Probability that gives confidence level. (Typically 0.05)

firstInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the first group of data.

secondInputSeries
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The name of the series that stores the second group of data.

yIndex
:   Type: [System..::..Int32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/td2s409d)
    Index of the y.

#### Return Value

FTestResult class

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

This method returns the results of the F-test using an FTestResult object.

FTest performs a two-sample F-test to compare two population variances. For example, it can be used to determine whether the time scores in a swimming meet have a difference in variance for samples from two teams.

If a specified input series does not exist in the series collection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following code demonstrate how to calculate FTest.

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics; ........ FTestResult ftr = BasicStatisticalFormulas.FTest(0.05, series1, series2, 0); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics ........ Dim ftr As FTestResult = BasicStatisticalFormulas.FTest(0.05, series1, series2, 0) ``` | |

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Calculates Median of series X values.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static double Median( 	ChartSeries series ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function Median ( _ 	series As ChartSeries _ ) As Double ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static double Median( 	ChartSeries^ series ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function Median( 	series : ChartSeries ) : double ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.Median = function(series); ``` |

#### Parameters

series
:   Type: Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart..::..ChartSeries
    The input series

#### Return Value

[Missing <returns> documentation for "M:Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.Median(Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.ChartSeries)"]

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

Use this method to calculate the median of the points stored in a series.
The median is the middle value of a sample set, where half of the members are greater in size and half the members are lesser in size.

if the specified input series does not exist in the SeriesCollection at the time of the method call than an exception will be thrown.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

The following Code demonstrate how to gets the median of the data points in a series

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` using Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics;    ............    double Median1= Statistics.BasicStatisticalFormulas.Median(series1); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` Imports Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart.Statistics    .............    Dim Median1 As Double    Median1=BasicStatisticalFormulas.Median(series1) ``` | |

| IChartSeriesIndexedModel Interface |
| Members [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Interface that is to be implemented if you want the ChartControl to be able to display your indexed data (X value is not needed). The ChartControl is totally agnostic
about the data it displays. Even the default series store is an implementation of IChartSeriesModel. When you implement this interface,
you can set it as the data underlying any ChartSeries object using the SeriesIndexedModelImpl. When you
use this model for a series, you have to set ChartControl's Indexed property to be True.

| ChartSeries..::..OnPrepareSeriesStyleInfo Method |
| ChartSeries Class [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

After composing the style of each series, the chart's style system will call this method before the style is used for display.
Override this method if you wish to change the contents of the series ChartStyleInfo object that is passed in. For instance, if
you wish to change the back color of the series being rendered based on external criteria, you could check this criteria when this
method gets called and change the color of the series based on such. Note that any changes made to the style object in this method
are not permanent but are temporary and lasts only for the current rendering cycle. This makes this method
a convenient place to set transient data based attributes.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Windows.Forms.Chart
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Chart.Base (in Syncfusion.Chart.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

Remember that second derivatives should be calculated in naturalSpline function and
